io.name: clk
io.description: Clock input; all sampling occurs on the posedge of clk.

io.name: d
io.description: Data input sampled on the posedge of clk.

io.name: r
io.description: Active high synchronous reset input; when high at a posedge, q is reset to 0.

io.name: q
io.description: Registered output; reflects d sampled at the previous posedge, or 0 if reset was active.

functional_summary.overview: A single-bit D flip-flop with active-high synchronous reset. On each rising edge of clk, if r is high then q is set to 0; otherwise q captures the value of d. Output q updates one clock cycle after the sampled edge.
rules: On posedge clk: if r == 1, then q <= 0.
On posedge clk: if r == 0, then q <= d.
q holds its value between posedges of clk.
Reset is synchronous: r only affects q at a posedge of clk.
Output q has a latency of 1 clock cycle relative to the sampled inputs.
